text:
Eli: Quick idea  tiny stair sprint challenge at 3pm? 3 rounds up+down, friendly timing. Winner buys the office pizza. :pizza:
Tara: Ha! I'm in if we let slow-mo powerwalkers join. My calves are wary. :sweat_smile:
Mina: Count me in. Any rules on sneakers? I only have flats today.
Juno: I can lend spare trainers size 8.5. Also, can we do a lanes system so people aren't blocking?
StretchBot: Event created: Stair Sprint @15:00. Suggested safety rules:
- Walk if stairs are wet
- No sprinting while carrying stuff
- Two lanes: up (fast) and down (steady)
- Optional timing using `/timer start`
Eli: Good call StretchBot. We'll set two lanes and one volunteer marshal at each end.
Tara: Poll: :pizza: classic pepperoni, :green_salad: salad, or :calories: try all (pizza + salad). React to vote.
Mina: Reacted :pizza:
Juno: Reacted :green_salad: (I'm boring)
Eli: Reacted :calories: (I want both)
StretchBot: Current tally: pizza 1, salad 1, both 1. Poll closes at 14:30.
Tara: If pizza wins I will accept IOU slices. Also, can we set a 3-minute warmup at 14:55?
Mina: I'll lead warmup  ankle circles, dynamic hamstring swings, 2 slow step-ups.
Juno: See you all at the stairwell landing. Winner picks the playlist. :headphones:
